source='''from collections import Counter, deque

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen=set(); comps=[]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] == bg or (r,c) in seen: continue
            q=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); comp=[]
            while q:
                x,y=q.pop(); comp.append((x,y,grid[x][y]))
                for nx,ny in ((x-1,y),(x+1,y),(x,y-1),(x,y+1)):
                    if 0<=nx<h and 0<=ny<w and (nx,ny) not in seen and grid[nx][ny]!=bg:
                        seen.add((nx,ny)); q.append((nx,ny))
            comps.append(comp)
    templates=[co for co in comps if len(co)>1]
    markers=[co[0][:2] for co in comps if len(co)==1]
    if not templates or not markers: return [row[:] for row in grid]
    template=max(templates,key=len)
    r0=min(p[0] for p in template); r1=max(p[0] for p in template)
    c0=min(p[1] for p in template); c1=max(p[1] for p in template)
    ar=(r0+r1)//2; ac=(c0+c1)//2
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for mr,mc in markers:
        for r,c,v in template:
            nr=mr+(r-ar); nc=mc+(c-ac)
            if 0<=nr<h and 0<=nc<w: out[nr][nc]=v
    return out
'''
file=programs/'task-44eef5cb.py'; file.write_text(source)
